Proto-Indo-Iranian *gʰr̥dʰás Sanskrit गृह (gṛha) Proto-Middle Indo-Aryan *𑀕𑀭𑁆𑀳 (*garha) Prakrit 𑀖𑀭 (ghara) Hindi घर Inherited from Prakrit 𑀖𑀭 (ghara, a metathesized form of Sanskrit गृह (gṛha)), from Proto-Middle Indo-Aryan *𑀕𑀭𑁆𑀳 (*garha), from Sanskrit गृह (gṛha), from Proto-Indo-Iranian *gʰr̥dʰás, from Proto-Indo-European *gʰerdʰ-.

Inherited from Sauraseni Prakrit 𑀘𑀺𑀢𑁆𑀢𑀕 (cittaga), from Sanskrit चित्रक (citraka, “leopard”), from चित्र (citra, “variegated, spotted”) + Middle Indo-Aryan -𑀓- (-ka-), referring to the spots on the fur of a leopard. Cognate with Bengali চিতা (cita), Gujarati ચિત્તો (citto), Marathi चित्ता (cittā). Doublet of चित्र (citra) and चेहरा (cehrā).
Inherited from Prakrit छोयर (choyara). Related to छोकरा (chokrā) and छोहरा (chohrā). Cognate with Nepali छोरो (choro), Bengali ছোঁড়া (chō̃ṛa).

Borrowed from Classical Persian تعجب (ta'ajjub), from Arabic تَعَجُّب (taʕajjub).
